curated.title: Private sanatorium of Dr. A. Eder, Vienna (Hans Auer): first and second floor plans, Allgemeine Bauzeitung 1888, plate 5
curated.why: Two ward floors of a Viennese sanatorium by the Bundeshaus architect on one engraved plate, rooms marked by letters explained in a legend: the hospital plan at about 50 px/m that replaces the 13 px/m Altein page.

attribution.author: Prof. Hans Auer (Allgemeine Bauzeitung 1888, Bl. 5; R. v. Waldheim art. Anst. Wien)
